messages.subject: For Kris Licht | Global affairs, sustainability and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Reckitt Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Kris Licht, Chief Executive Officer.

Reckitt's global health and hygiene portfolio operates across governments, regulators, communities and rapidly evolving sustainability expectations. That stakeholder environment aligns closely with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across a complex emerging-market operation.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and stakeholder execution might support Reckitt's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Reckitt.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
